note: ミイラ and xác ướp are the standard terms for an embalmed corpse.
蝉 and ve sầu are the common terms for cicada; the definition identifies the insect group rather than changing the headword.
平日 is the more common Japanese word for weekday; JMdict ent_seq 1507720, s0 glosses it as weekday and ordinary non-holiday days.
半球 and bán cầu are the standard terms for either half of the Earth or a sphere.
上段 and bục both denote a raised platform for an honored seat or a speaker.
血清 and huyết thanh are precise standard terms for blood serum.
採鉱 means the mining activity itself, whereas 鉱業 means the mining industry; khai thác mỏ matches the stated activity.
